content:
A crash at the intersection of Eva Sámano and Perú in Nuevo Laredo on Tuesday left three people injured, including a five-month-old baby, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo. The other two people injured were women, the outlet reported.

The crash was reported in Nuevo Laredo on Oct. 27, 2026. El Mañana's report identified the location as the Eva Sámano and Perú intersection and the injured as two women and the infant.

Sources:

  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "Choque en Nuevo Laredo deja lesionadas a dos mujeres y un bebé," Oct. 27, 2026
